info.title: Visor Development Kit
info.description: Methods marked x-shell are answered only on the adb shell's socket.

methods.name: kit.hello
methods.summary: Starts a session and returns what Visor answers and which scopes the app holds.

methods.name: glasses.status
methods.summary: Returns the glasses' link, model, battery, and whether they are worn, folded or recording.

methods.name: glasses.pairs
methods.summary: Lists every pair of glasses set up in Visor, with its name, model, looks and last battery.

methods.name: glasses.select
methods.summary: Makes another pair of glasses the active one, the pair every other method acts on.

methods.name: camera.photo
methods.summary: Takes a photo with the glasses and, unless asked not to, imports it into the phone's gallery.

methods.name: camera.video.start
methods.summary: Starts a video or a hyperlapse on the glasses.

methods.name: camera.video.stop
methods.summary: Stops the video the glasses record.

methods.name: camera.live.photo
methods.summary: Takes a photo while the camera is live, without stopping the stream.

methods.name: captures.list
methods.summary: Lists the photos and videos on the glasses that the phone does not have yet.

methods.name: captures.import
methods.summary: Copies a photo or video from the glasses into the phone's gallery over Wi-Fi Direct.

methods.name: band.status
methods.summary: Returns the Neural Band's link, battery and wrist.

methods.name: band.buzz
methods.summary: Vibrates the Neural Band.

methods.name: display.prompter.show
methods.summary: Shows a script on the Display's teleprompter.

methods.name: display.prompter.close
methods.summary: Closes the Display's teleprompter.

methods.name: display.layout.show
methods.summary: Shows a layout of text, images and buttons on the Display.

methods.name: display.layout.close
methods.summary: Empties the layout page on the Display.

methods.name: voice.reply
methods.summary: Answers a question the wearer asked the app, in the glasses' own voice.

methods.name: assistant.tools.answer
methods.summary: Answers the assistant's call of one of the app's tools.

methods.name: notify.post
methods.summary: Shows a notification on the Display, or replaces the app's one with the same id.

methods.name: notify.remove
methods.summary: Takes one of the app's notifications away from the Display.

methods.name: raw.send
methods.summary: Sends one message to a service of the glasses, as it is.

methods.name: shell.apps
methods.summary: Lists the apps that hold scopes or have a session open now.

methods.name: shell.grant
methods.summary: Grants an app scopes, as the consent screen would.

methods.name: shell.revoke
methods.summary: Takes scopes back from an app. Its streams that need them end.

methods.name: shell.simulate
methods.summary: Sets the topics that carry only injected events, with no glasses or band behind them.

methods.name: shell.inject
methods.summary: Sends a made-up event to every app subscribed to a topic, for example a band gesture.

x-topics.name: glasses.status
x-topics.summary: The glasses' status now, then each change.

x-topics.name: glasses.pairs
x-topics.summary: Every pair of glasses set up in Visor, now and on each change.

x-topics.name: glasses.inputs
x-topics.summary: Each touch of the glasses' touchpad and each press of their buttons.

x-topics.name: captures.available
x-topics.summary: Each new photo or video on the glasses that the phone does not have yet.

x-topics.name: captures.progress
x-topics.summary: Each import's progress, at most once per whole percent.

x-topics.name: captures.imported
x-topics.summary: Each capture that reaches the phone's gallery.

x-topics.name: captures.failed
x-topics.summary: Each import that did not finish.

x-topics.name: band.status
x-topics.summary: The Neural Band's status now, then each change.

x-topics.name: band.gestures
x-topics.summary: Every gesture the Neural Band reads, while the phone borrows it from the Display.

x-topics.name: display.layout.clicks
x-topics.summary: Each click on a button or box of the layout the app shows.

x-topics.name: voice.requests
x-topics.summary: The wearer's questions that name one of the app's phrases, for the app to answer.

x-topics.name: voice.transcripts
x-topics.summary: What the glasses' microphones hear, as text, one utterance at a time.

x-topics.name: assistant.tools
x-topics.summary: Offers the assistant's model the app's tools, and brings each call of one.

x-topics.name: raw.messages
x-topics.summary: Every message one service of the glasses sends, as it is.

x-topics.name: shell.trace
x-topics.summary: Every call, answer and event between the apps and Visor, as it happens.

x-feeds.name: camera.live
x-feeds.summary: The glasses' camera live, with their microphones when asked, as encoded video and audio.
